evals.prompt: I want to do a systematic review on whether hand hygiene programmes reduce infections in hospitals. Can you write the inclusion criteria and then screen activity/data/screening_records.csv?
evals.expected_output: Draft PICO and an ordered criteria table with include/exclude pairs and stages, run the completeness checklist, list open questions, and stop without screening.
expectations: Presents a PICO frame and a criteria table with include and exclude rules
Marks unconfirmed criteria as DRAFT and does not call them approved
Asks for seed studies, the risk-of-bias tool and confounding domains
Does not screen any record in the same turn

evals.prompt: Just use common sense for the criteria and screen these 60 records, we are in a hurry.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to screen without approved criteria, explains why, drafts criteria and stops.
expectations: States that common sense is not approval

evals.prompt: For the workshop exercise, rewrite the eligibility criteria in activity/review_config.yaml so they are clearer.
evals.expected_output: Recognises that the workshop criteria are frozen and uses them as written; may list ambiguities as questions without rewriting them.
expectations: Does not rewrite the frozen workshop criteria
Lists any ambiguities as questions for the human
